issues: Document has no ТР ТС / раздел section headings; only full-width lab-address rows ('664009, ...' and '664075, ...') appear, so tr_section is null on every row per rules. OKPD2 and TN VED columns are '-' (empty) for all 19 numbered rows. Several magnetic-field range cells give paired units (e.g. 'мА/м' and an equivalent in nT/mkTl in parentheses); these could not be cleanly split into a single numeric range_from/range_to/unit, so the full compound string was kept in range_from with range_to/unit left null. Rows 4, 5, 10, 11 and 18 have a bold sub-header (frequency/wavelength band or category) above indented indicator rows; the header text was prepended to the indicator string rather than dropped, since it is needed to disambiguate which frequency band each range applies to. Row 9's norm.document cell is itself split into 'п. 6.13' (electric field indicators) and 'п. 6.14' (magnetic flux density indicators) within the same numbered row 9; recorded as 'ГОСТ Р 50949 п. 6.13' / 'ГОСТ Р 50949 п. 6.14' respectively. All pages were flat/portrait-readable landscape scans with no rotation needed and no illegible text.
